# Evidence register

<!-- Generated by cargo lab docs generate; edit registry YAML instead. -->

Evidence manifests record provenance, artifact references and SHA-256 digests. Displaying a manifest does not verify content, accessibility or reviewer acceptance. The [verification workflow](execution-and-evidence.md#verify-retained-content) checks actual content or an explicit local mirror. The [existing evidence bundle contract](../06-benchmarking/evidence-and-traceability.md#proposed-evidence-bundle) defines retained raw inputs and observations.
